title: russell1000 top-3 agent-loop trio (XGBoost; L1+L2+#184 lessons applied)

r_precision_at_k_methodology_note.definition: R-Precision@K = (1/Q) * sum_{q in Q} r_q / min(K, R_q), where Q is the set of days with R_q > 0 positives, R_q is the count of positives on day q, r_q is the count of positives in the top-K picks on day q. Macro-averaged across days, equal weight per day. K is fixed (per-day variable-K under the legacy 'weighted R-precision' metric used the per-day R(d) as K; macro-averaged R-Precision@K uses a fixed K and the min(K, R_q) denominator for achievability). See .claude/memories/project-r-precision-methodology.md for the full definition and the relationship to the legacy metric.
r_precision_at_k_methodology_note.memo_body_uses: R-Precision@K (unlike _192 and _193 which kept legacy weighted R-precision in their bodies and surfaced R-Precision@K in a dedicated section at the bottom; this memo writes the body directly against R-Precision@K).

cross_universe_comparison_r_precision_at.headline_finding: nasdaq100 (92-ticker panel) wins R-p@10 at all 3 matched cells; russell1000 (889-ticker panel) trails on every R-p@10 head-to-head. r1k AUC matches/beats nas at all 3 cells but trails sp500 AUC on the 2 cells where sp data exists. Wider panel under-performs smaller panels on R-Precision@K at rare-event targets.
